title: An Open-label, Multicenter Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Emapalumab Treatment in Children and Adults With Secondary Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis or Post-Chimeric Antigen Receptor Therapy Hyperinflammation
official: An Open-label, Multicenter Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Emapalumab Treatment in Children and Adults With Secondary Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis or Post-Chimeric Antigen Receptor Therapy Hyperinflammation
summary:
The purpose of this Phase 3 multicenter, open-label trial is to prospectively evaluate emapalumab in participants with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (sHLH) associated with lymphoma or Epstein-Barr virus-associated lymphoproliferative disorder (EBV-LPD), with the goal of improving 60-day overall survival and allowing physicians an opportunity to effectively treat the underlying etiology responsible for driving the hyperinflammatory flare.

The primary trial population (Cohort 1) for evaluation will consist of participants with sHLH and a diagnosis of either lymphoma or EBV-LPD. Exploratory cohorts (Cohort 2) will evaluate participants with sHLH not associated with lymphoma or EBV-LPD and participants treated with two post-Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) therapy toxicities (Cohorts 3A and 3B).
criteria:
General inclusion criteria (all cohorts):

* Informed consent provided by the participant or by the participant's legally acceptable representative(s) with the assent of participants who are legally capable of providing it, as required by local law.
* Female participants of childbearing potential and who are sexually active and male participants who are sexually active must agree to use highly effective methods of contraception.

Note: Prior or concomitant steroid treatment does not affect eligibility for enrollment in this trial.

Inclusion criteria for Cohort 1:

* Male or female participants \<80 years of age at screening.
* Have a diagnosis of lymphoma or Epstein-Barr virus-associated lymphoproliferative disorder (EBV-LPD), as determined by the investigator, and have not received a CAR therapy in the prior 60 days. A diagnosis of EBV-LPD should include evidence of cellular atypia without overt dysplasia, no immunophenotypic evidence of lymphoma, and no monoclonal populations by T-cell or B-cell receptor sequencing.
* Meet at least 4 of the following 8 criteria during screening:

  1. Fever ≥38.5ºC.
  2. Splenomegaly.
  3. Cytopenia as defined as at least two of the following (hemoglobin \<9 g/dL, platelets \<100×10\^9/L, neutrophils \<1.0×10\^9/L).
  4. Triglycerides ≥265 mg/dL and/or Fibrinogen ≤1.5 g/dL.
  5. Hemophagocytosis.
  6. Low or absent NK-cell activity.
  7. Ferritin ≥500 μg/L.
  8. sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL (or above local lab reference range).

Inclusion criteria for Cohort 2:

* Male or female participants \<80 years of age at screening.
* Does not have a diagnosis of lymphoma or EBV-LPD and have not received a CAR therapy in the prior 60 days.
* Meet at least 4 of the following 8 criteria during screening:

  1. Fever ≥38.5ºC.
  2. Splenomegaly.
  3. Cytopenia as defined as at least two of the following (hemoglobin \<9 g/dL, platelets \<100×10\^9/L, neutrophils \<1.0×10\^9/L).
  4. Triglycerides ≥265 mg/dL and/or Fibrinogen ≤1.5 g/dL.
  5. Hemophagocytosis.
  6. Low or absent NK-cell activity.
  7. Ferritin ≥500 μg/L.
  8. sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL (or above local lab reference range).

Inclusion criteria for Cohort 3A:

* Male or female participants of any age who have received an intravenous autologous CAR therapy for treatment of leukemia, lymphoma, or multiple myeloma in the prior 45 days. Receipt of an investigational CAR therapy in the prior 45 days may be eligible if, per the investigational CAR therapy trial protocol, participation in another clinical trial is allowed.
* Elevated ferritin, defined as a value that is both (1) greater than the ferritin level recorded on the day of the CAR infusion, and (2) at least 5×ULN.
* Platelet count \<50,000/μL or absolute neutrophil count \<1000/μL.
* At least two of the four following laboratory criteria:

  1. Hypofibrinogenemia (\<150 mg/dL OR \< LLN).
  2. AST elevation (\>3×ULN).
  3. ALT elevation (\>3×ULN).
  4. Hypertriglyceridemia (\>265 mg/dL OR \> 1.5×ULN).
* Onset of IEC-HS with resolving/resolved Grade ≤3 cytokine release syndrome (CRS) or worsening inflammatory response with \>24 hours of CRS-directed therapy.

Inclusion criteria for Cohort 3B:

* Male or female participants of any age who have received an intravenous autologous CAR therapy for treatment of leukemia, lymphoma, or multiple myeloma in the prior 45 days. Receipt of an investigational CAR therapy in the prior 45 days may be eligible if, per the investigational CAR therapy trial protocol, participation in another clinical trial is allowed.
* Grade 2+ CRS with progression despite initial treatment with glucocorticoids for ≥48 hours AND 1 or 2 doses of tocilizumab (i.e., inadequate response to GCs and tocilizumab).

Exclusion Criteria for all cohorts:

* Active, relapsed/refractory, or end-stage malignancy for which no suitable therapies are available to treat the malignancy.
* Known diagnosis of or suspected (e.g. due to family history of) primary HLH.
* Known or suspected Still's disease (including systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis and adult-onset Still's disease).
* Clinically active mycobacteria (typical and atypical), Histoplasma capsulatum, Leishmania, or Salmonella.
* Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (documented prior diagnosis in the medical record).
* Evidence of latent tuberculosis (TB).
* Receipt of a Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) vaccine within 12 weeks prior to screening.
* Receipt of a live or attenuated live (other than BCG) vaccine within 4 weeks prior to screening.
* Pregnant or lactating females.
* Known allergy to emapalumab or any of its excipients.
* Any clinically relevant abnormality which makes the participant unsuitable for participation in the trial, in the opinion of the investigator.
* Considered unable or unwilling to comply with the trial protocol requirements.
* Receipt of any other medicinal product under investigation (with the exception of investigational CAR therapy for Cohort 3 in the prior 45 days before screening).
